name: No Trucks
spec: white square with a black truck symbol inside a red circle with a red diagonal slash
meaning: Trucks are not allowed on this road.

snippets.back: A No Trucks sign bars trucks from the posted area.
No Trucks and No Bicycles are examples of prohibition signs alongside No Left Turn, No Right Turn and No U-Turn.
A No Trucks sign excludes trucks from the indicated street or highway.
NO TRUCKS, NO BICYCLES and NO PEDESTRIAN CROSSING signs prohibit the indicated road user from using the posted roadway.
No Trucks identifies a regulatory restriction directed at truck traffic.

result.summary: Meaning supported by MI, MS, and PA prohibition statements; no snippet describes shape, color, or legend.
